title: 4.1.6 Q1 Synthesis Project
description: Q1 synthesis: build a program that meets a checklist of requirements. Arrays of objects, functions, sorting, save/load, and your own tests — the rest is your call.

steps.title: Plan before you code
steps.instructions: A short pitch in README.md: what the program does. Written before any build time, so the rest of this list has something to serve.

steps.title: An array of at least 5 objects of your own design, each with multiple properties
A function of your own with at least 3 parameters
A function of your own that returns a computed value, used elsewhere in the program
A loop that reads your array
A conditional that makes a decision based on your data
Save and load your data with localStorage + JSON
One formatted console.log verdict line combining at least two computed results
Three PASS/FAIL manual tests of your own logic, including one edge case
README, comments, and style guide compliance
steps.instructions: Appendix A applies. The README says what the program does, how to run it, and, per Appendix D: what changed from your A4.1.0 chart and why.

requirements.title: An array of your own
requirements.description: An array you declared to hold your data

requirements.title: Five objects stored
requirements.description: At least five objects, each with your own properties. The checker cannot judge whether your object design is good; the teacher reads for that.

requirements.title: A 3+ parameter function
requirements.description: A function of your own with at least 3 parameters

requirements.title: A function that returns a value
requirements.description: A function of your own that returns a computed value, used elsewhere in the program. A named function, an arrow, or a method all count.

requirements.title: A sort
requirements.description: A sort over your array — a built-in .sort() or a sort you wrote by hand

requirements.title: Uses a loop
requirements.description: A `for`, `while`, or `for...of` loop somewhere in the program (e.g. walking your array)

requirements.title: Uses a conditional
requirements.description: An `if` statement or `switch` statement somewhere in the program

requirements.title: Saves and loads with localStorage + JSON
Prints a formatted verdict
requirements.description: A console.log that prints one formatted line combining at least two things you calculated

requirements.title: Tests report PASS or FAIL
requirements.description: A check that prints PASS when it matches the known answer and FAIL when it does not. The checker cannot count your tests: three is on you, and the teacher reads for it.
